series_iii.description: Main key/keyway polarization for series III. The insert arrangement does not rotate with the main key/keyway.

series_iv.description: Main key/keyway polarization for series IV. The minor key/keyway polarity arrangements (N, A, B, C, D, K, L, M, R) apply to all shell sizes (note 5), while the main key/keyway angles P/Q/R/S vary by shell size. The insert arrangement does not rotate with the main key/keyway. Series IV is defined for shell sizes 11 through 25 (no shell size 9).

K.note: K polarization: see note 16 for U2/UU2/Z2 key/keyway width increase on Y/YY positions.

main_key_by_shell_size.angle_format: Values are printed in degrees-minutes (the *_dms fields); the *_deg fields are decimal-degree equivalents.

series_iv.description: Real main-key/keyway diameters and key/keyway widths for series IV (figure 7). Polarization is set by the angular position of the minor keys, not by their width, so all minor polarizing keys share one nominal width per shell size; the K polarization key/keyway is wider (note 16). The main key/keyway (W1/W2) is dimensioned separately from the polarizing keys. Key and keyway widths scale with shell size (≈ proportional to shell diameter).
series_iv.units: millimeters (mm) with inch equivalents (in) for reference

column_legend.U: polarity (minor) key width; U2 (all polarizations except K) equals U
column_legend.U2_K: polarity key width for K polarization only (wider, note 16)
column_legend.UU_max: maximum keyway width; UU2 (except K) equals UU max
column_legend.UU2_K_max: maximum keyway width for K polarization only (note 16)
column_legend.W1_pin: main keyway width, pin contact (BSC); blank on drawing for shells 17/21/25
column_legend.W2_socket: main keyway width, socket contact (BSC); blank on drawing for shells 17/21/25

derived_render_ratios.k_polarization_keyway_width_factor_basis: mean of UU2(K max) / UU(max) across shell sizes 11-25
derived_render_ratios.main_keyway_to_minor_keyway_width_factor: mean of W2(socket BSC) / UU(max) across shells that list W2 (11,13,15,19,23)
